title: Graph Data Model Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners click each node and edge in a small Customer-Order-Product graph to reveal its type and properties, then answer five identification questions about the graph data model.

learningObjectives: Explain the graph data model by identifying nodes, edges, and properties in a visual graph representation.
prerequisites: Graph Data Model and Nodes and Edges sections of Chapter 6

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration followed by identification questions
keyQuestions: Explain the graph data model by identifying nodes, edges, and properties in a visual graph representation.
commonMisconceptions: Nodes and edges are the same.
Graph models are the same as relational models.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner can explain why `value: "$5,000"` belongs on the *placed* edge rather than on either node.
